mentions.name: qite-js
mentions.description: A JavaScript frontend framework that requires no build step, relies on the DOM and server-side rendering, and can build both SPA and hybrid apps without virtual DOM, JavaScript templates, hydration, or putting HTML or CSS inside JavaScript code. It is planned to include a sophisticated declarative state manager that makes managing state and UI transitions easy, positioning itself as an anti-React alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: Frontend framework in JavaScript that requires no build step, relies on DOM and SSR and can be used to build both SPA and hybrid apps without VDOM, js templates, hydration or putting HTML (or worse, css) inside JS code. It'll also have a very sophisticated declarative state manager which makes managing state and ui transitions a breeze. It's basically anti-React.
